officialAA.name: Searing Arrows
officialAA.description: Imbues Clinkz's arrows with fire for extra damage.
officialAA.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Grants Burning Army, whose skeletons fire arrows that deal a percentage of your attack damage and apply your attack effects.

officialAA.name: Shadow Dance
officialAA.description: When used, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark. Passively, when not visible to the enemy team, Slark gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration.
officialAA.superUpgrade: Super: +1s duration, +50 attack speed while under Shadow Dance's effect.

officialAA.name: Sleight of Fist
officialAA.description: Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location. Deals bonus damage to heroes.
officialAA.superUpgrade: Super: Has +1000 extra cast range and gains True Strike.

officialAA.name: Spear of Mars
officialAA.description: Caster throws a legendary Spear with deadly precision through the entire arena, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. When the skewered hero hits the arena wall, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
officialAA.superUpgrade: Super: Impales up to 2 units and leaves a fire trail behind for 10 seconds. Deals 35 damage per second and slows by 20%. Debuff lingers for 2 seconds. Increases damage by 100 and stun duration by 1s.
officialAA.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Spear range increased by 1600, and bounces off the arena wall 2 times. Skewered units are pinned at the wall before the bounce.

officialAA.name: Spirit Lance
officialAA.description: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
officialAA.superUpgrade: Super: Cooldown reduced by 4 seconds, and cast range increased by 225. Spirit Lance bounces once on an enemy within 750 radius, prioritizing heroes. Increases Spirit Lance illusion damage by +40%
officialAA.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Grants 25% cooldown reduction and +45 to base stat.
